goal: Protect nodes from memory exhaustion and slow deserialization caused by crafted witness data
Stop peers from inducing large memory allocations with malformed transactions or blocks
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now as nothing is known to invalidate it
agreement: Broad concept support for mitigating exceptional transaction memory bloat (furszy, 0xB10C, instagibbs)
Verified by testing on Windows after initial efficiency suggestions were addressed (Yudis-bit)
Unaddressed objection: memory allocation remains high for unknown witness versions (fametrano)
Approach objection: excessive churn across 76 files before abstracting data access (purpleKarrot)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because it closes a denial-of-service vector where peers trigger large allocations before rejection
Untrusted peers can no longer force nodes to allocate excess memory for oversized payloads

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it removes a severe block deserialization denial-of-service vulnerability
Worst-case block deserialization drops from 279 ms to 19 ms and peak memory drops from 182 MiB to 8 MiB
